slides.title: The years to avoid, and the one I bought.
slides.body: I bought my 2007 G 500 knowing exactly which years to skip. Here's what the sources say. Swipe.

slides.credit: W463 300 GD · Ben - PTM11 · CC BY-SA 4.0
slides.title: Early US trucks have the gremlins.
slides.body: Seat motors, window regulators, door-lock and transfer-case actuators. Handsome Motors and Expedition Portal owners say the same.

slides.title: The G 500 sweet spot.
slides.body: The early electrical faults were mostly gone by 2005–06, and 2007 brought the seven-speed, HID lights and a reversing camera to the US.

slides.credit: W463 G 55 on the Schöckl · Bahnfrend · CC BY-SA 3.0
slides.title: Newer isn't always better.
slides.body: The G 550 arrived for 2009, the twin-turbo for 2016. Handsome Motors calls 2016–18 reliable but rates 2002–15 trucks higher.

end.title: Which year is yours?
end.body: Every W463 year with the reasons, the recalls and a free inspection checklist.
